title: Noether-Type Theorems and the Generalized Herglotz Principle in $q$-Contact Geometry
summary: We develop a unified geometric framework for dissipative mechanical systems based on uniform $q$-contact manifolds, which provide an extended phase space equipped with multiple contact $1$-forms. Within this setting, we construct both Hamiltonian and Lagrangian formalisms and establish a generalized Noether-type theorem describing the relationship between symmetries and dissipated quantities.
